description: Make the Contributor Details card show the contributor's profile photo (with initials fallback) AND open cleanly from the correct anchored position, consistently across ALL FIVE skins (aurora, classic, festival, premium, slate). Today only the premium skin opens ContributorDetail at all, and even there the card shows only the initials avatar. This feature (1) adds the photo to the shared ContributorDetail.svelte, (2) fixes its open/anchor/positioning so it presents as a clean backdrop modal/bottom-sheet with no overlap or scroll-jump and consistent with Modal.svelte conventions, and (3) wires tap-to-open-detail through the shared list modal and each skin's contributor rows so the detail card (with photo) is reachable in every theme. Requirement quote: 'Profile photo ye details wala card me bhi aana chahiye or on click user details card sahi jgh se khulna chahiye or sabhi theme me'.
steps: PHOTO IN DETAIL CARD (shared, benefits all skins): In src/lib/components/ContributorDetail.svelte, render the contributor photo using the SAME pattern as src/lib/components/ContributorCard.svelte. Add a `photoFailed` $state and a $effect that resets it when the contributor changes (reset on `c?.photo`/`entry` change). Replace the initials-only avatar block with: `{#if c.photo && !photoFailed} (photoFailed = true)} />{:else}{/if}`. Preserve the current avatar sizing (h-20 w-20 rounded-full) and any ring/border/shadow so it matches the existing card; keep the initials avatar exactly as-is for the fallback. The image must be decorative-consistent with the card (alt = displayName).

DETAIL CARD OPEN POSITION (shared): Read ContributorDetail.svelte's current outer wrapper (backdrop `fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end justify-center ... sm:items-center sm:p-4`, sheet `rounded-b-none rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl`, use:dialog) and compare to Modal.svelte (z-[60], `max-h-[85vh] ... flex-col overflow-hidden`, internal `overflow-y-auto` body). Make ContributorDetail present cleanly and consistently: give the sheet a max-height and an internal scroll region so a tall card never overflows/overlaps surrounding cards (mirror Modal.svelte: e.g. constrain height and put the scrollable content in an `overflow-y-auto min-h-0` region), ensure the backdrop covers the viewport and the sheet is centered on desktop / bottom-sheet on mobile, and ensure opening does not cause a scroll-jump (use:dialog already locks body scroll and manages focus — keep that). Keep z-index above page content and consistent with the app's modal layering. Do not regress the existing use:dialog focus-trap/Esc/return behaviour.

TAP-TO-OPEN IN ALL SKINS via the shared list modal: In src/lib/components/ContributorsListModal.svelte, make each contributor row open the detail card. Add an `onselect?: (key: string) => void` prop (or mount ContributorDetail internally with its own selected state) so tapping a row shows ContributorDetail for that contributor. Prefer a self-contained approach: keep a `selected` $state inside ContributorsListModal, render <ContributorDetail entry={selected} onclose={() => selected = null} /> from it, and set selected on row click (rows become <button>). This makes the detail card (with photo) reachable from the 'Contributors 2026' list in every skin that opens the list modal (aurora, premium). Ensure nested-dialog layering is correct (detail card must appear above the list modal; use:dialog handles focus for the topmost).

TAP-TO-OPEN from each skin's own contributor UI: For skins whose Home renders contributors inline and are NOT tappable today, wire tap-to-open ContributorDetail. premium already does this via LiveScroll onselect — leave/keep it. For aurora/pages/Home.svelte (own horizontal rail) and classic/festival/slate/pages/Home.svelte (vertical lists), make each contributor row/card a button that sets a `selected` Ranked<Contributor> state and mount `<ContributorDetail entry={selected} onclose={() => (selected = null)} />` at the end of the page (import type { Ranked } from '$lib/utils/ranking' and type { Contributor } from '$lib/api/derive'; find the ranked entry by key or bind the entry directly). Keep each skin's existing row markup/styling; only add the click-to-open behaviour and the ContributorDetail mount. NOTE: if converting a skin's rail to the shared LiveScroll in FEAT-003, coordinate so the onselect wiring is not duplicated — prefer that the tap-to-open added here and the LiveScroll onselect added in FEAT-003 converge on the same `selected` state.

Keep everything themed: ContributorDetail uses `surface`, `chip`, `brand-*`, `dark:` utility classes that are driven by per-skin CSS variables, so the shared fixes restyle automatically. Do not hardcode skin-specific colors.

TESTS: Add a jsdom component/logic test for the photo-vs-initials decision. If a small pure helper is introduced (e.g. `shouldShowPhoto(photo, failed)`), unit-test it as a node test. For the render behaviour, add a test file with `// @vitest-environment jsdom` that mounts ContributorDetail with (a) a contributor that has a photo -> asserts an with the right src is rendered, (b) photo='' -> asserts the initials avatar is rendered, and (c) simulating the img error path falls back to initials. Follow the existing test style in src/lib/a11y/dialog.test.ts and the vitest jsdom opt-in convention.

Run the full gate from Public/frontend-v6: `npm run check` (no new warnings), `npm test`, `npm run build`. Fix any svelte-check warnings introduced (CI fails on warnings). Confirm the client-JS budget gates still pass (npm run build then node scripts/first-load-bytes.mjs --limit 420000; total immutable JS <= 700000 bytes).
acceptance_criteria: ContributorDetail.svelte renders the contributor's profile photo (an with src = c.photo) when c.photo is non-empty and the image loads, and falls back to the existing initials gradient avatar when c.photo is '' OR the image errors; the avatar keeps its h-20 w-20 rounded-full sizing.

ContributorDetail opens as a clean backdrop modal/bottom-sheet (centered on desktop, bottom-sheet on mobile) with a max-height + internal scroll for tall content, does not visually overlap the underlying cards, and does not cause a scroll-jump on open; use:dialog focus-trap/Esc/scroll-lock/focus-return still work.

A contributor detail card (with photo) can be opened by tapping a contributor in ALL FIVE skins — via the shared ContributorsListModal rows and/or each skin's own contributor rows/rail — not just premium.
New tests assert: photo present -> rendered; no photo -> initials rendered; img error -> initials fallback. `npm test` passes including the new tests.
`npm run check` (no new warnings), `npm test`, and `npm run build` in Public/frontend-v6 all pass, and the CI JS-size budgets (total <= 700000 bytes; first-load <= 420000 bytes) still hold.
verification: Run `export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" && cd Public/frontend-v6 && npm run check && npm test && npm run build`.
Run `node scripts/first-load-bytes.mjs --limit 420000` from Public/frontend-v6 and confirm it passes; confirm total immutable JS is under 700000 bytes.
Read the new test file and confirm it exercises the photo-present, no-photo, and img-error-fallback paths of ContributorDetail (the tests would fail if the photo were removed).
findings: IMPLEMENTED (all in Public/frontend-v6): 1) PHOTO IN DETAIL CARD — ContributorDetail.svelte now renders with an initials fallback, matching ContributorCard. Added `let photoFailed = $state(false)` + `$effect(() => { void c?.photo; photoFailed = false; })`. Extracted a tiny pure helper `shouldShowPhoto(photo, failed)` in src/lib/utils/format.ts and used it as the {#if} condition so the decision is centralised and unit-testable. 2) OPEN POSITION — ContributorDetail's outer panel now mirrors Modal.svelte: backdrop bumped z-50 -> z-[60] (consistent modal layering, and so the detail card layers above the list modal which is z-[60] too but mounted later); panel is now `flex max-h-[85vh] w-full max-w-sm flex-col overflow-hidden ... sm:max-h-[80vh]` with a fixed header (`shrink-0 p-5 pb-0`) and an internal scroll region `min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-5 pb-5`.
